reader.reads: Plotinus, Enneads I.6.5, in the Greek text of the public corpus, beside register A:E005.

thesis.ru: Душа, освободившись от страстей, связанных с телом, и очистившись, оставляет безобразное, пришедшее от иной природы; Плотин уподобляет это золоту, очищенному от земли.
thesis.en: The soul, freed from passions associated with the body and purified, lays aside the ugliness that came from another nature; Plotinus likens this to gold cleansed of earth.

conceptions.note: The register also names the Beautiful itself; these sentences speak of purification of the soul and the beauty of gold, so the conception follows those words.
